approval.text: I approve automatic GLM/DeepSeek OpenRouter delegation within £10 per month, £1 total per swarm run and £0.25 per worker task, with no automatic paid retries.

conservative_budget.judgment: A bounded-task hold used when the task does not name a smaller token budget. Not a measured usage figure.

classes.judgment: A native subscription coordinator may plan a shortlist worker for detailed but bounded work. This is not a quality ranking.
Coordinator review stays on the native subscription route.
Auth, money, deletion, and publication stay on the native subscription route.
